en.title: Profile
en.body:
Manage your account settings and personal information with Sri Murugan Jewellers.

**Account Information:**
• Update your personal details
• Manage your contact information
• Change your password and security settings
• View your account history

**Preferences:**
• Set your preferred language
• Choose notification preferences
• Manage privacy settings
• Customize your shopping experience

**Need Help?**
If you need assistance with your profile or account, please contact our support team at support@srimuruganjewellers.com or call +91 9876543210.
